title: bauhinia eriophora
intro: Bauhinia eriophora, commonly known as Orange Bauhinia or Golden Lotus, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Bauhinia eriophora include analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate pain, muscle spasms, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Bauhinia eriophora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
